title: A chinese work of art
text:
A chinese work of art. After using for a week or so, the rotating gear stuck and would not pull the can along for cutting.
After some inspection I noticed the button on TOP of the unit and pushed down on it. Voila!
The face of the cutting area popped off. I reseated the cutter head and it was now unstuck
and resumed working properly. Over the next few weeks this process was used as necessary.
You might have to use a butter knife to dislodge the head while pressing down on the button
if it sticks. Will not recommend to anyone.
